name: Wrists and Hands
description: Six small moves for the wrists and hands, easy to do at the keyboard.
author: Lullshift

help.summary: Small, easy moves for your wrists and hands, shown on Movement Routine.
help.goal: There is nothing to finish. Do a move or two, or the whole set.
howToPlay: Rest your hands off the keyboard and read the move.
Press Start timer for timed moves, or work through the counted ones at your own pace.
Press Next for the following move, or Skip to leave one out.
tips: General ideas for a break, not advice. Keep every move small and gentle, and stop if anything feels uncomfortable.
